label: The source says the opposite
description: The cited work states the opposite of what the sentence claims.

label: The study did not do that
description: The study is credited with a design or scope it did not have.

label: Data does not match the study
description: Molecules or findings are attributed to the study that are not its own.

label: Inflated figure
description: The stated magnitude is larger than what the source reports.

label: Figure taken out of context
description: The number exists in the source, but it refers to a different outcome.

label: One measure confused with another
description: The value is correct, but it corresponds to a different measure than the one named.

label: The source does not say that
description: The sentence attributes to the cited work content that the work does not report.

label: Overstated certainty
description: The sentence presents as established what the source reports as a hypothesis or an association.
